items.title: Rangers booed off after Europa League exit as McInnes' winless start goes on

items.summary: England head coach Lydia Bedford says she has been told to "just continue as usual" before next month's Under-20 Women's World Cup, despite the threat of a Uefa boycott over an ongoing row with Fifa.

items.title: Rangers crash out of Europa League as Derek McInnes’s winless start goes on
